thread:
jess-support: FYI customer acme-inc reports rerank results where all "scores" are 0.
jess-support: They also see an HTTP 200 with header `X-Model-Deprecated: true` on the same response. request id `req_0xabc123`.

jess-support: Repro steps they sent:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-live-XXX' \
  -d '{"model": "rerank-legacy-v1","inputs": ["q: how do i reset password","p: click settings ..." ] }'
```
jess-support: Body looks normal, but scores array is `[0,0,0]`.

sam-sdk: @jess-support quick Q: are they using an SDK version that rewrites aliases? we recently changed client-side alias resolution in 1.4.0.

jess-support: They said they're on `redwood-js@1.2.1` (old). Client likely uses cached mapping from alias -> model id. But server header says deprecated which is odd because we should return 404 for removed models.

kevin-infra: Pinging logs for `req_0xabc123`...
kevin-infra: Found it. Backend routing shows: request hit router -> matched alias `rerank-legacy` -> internal redirect to `rerank-compat-v2` (our compatibility shim) -> model served, but scorer returned all zeros due to mismatch in expected features (schema change). Shim returns 200 and sets `X-Model-Deprecated: true` to warn.

maria-ml: The compat shim intentionally returns successful responses for a while to avoid hard failures, but it should not return empty/zero scores. Looks like a feature mapping bug: old client sends `items` as flat strings, new scorer expects `documents` array with `text` field. Shim produced default zero scores when fields missing.

maria-ml: Minimal repro payload that triggers zeros on current runtime:
```
POST /v1/rerank
{"model":"rerank-legacy","inputs": ["How do I reset my password?"], "documents": null}
```

sam-sdk: So root cause is (1) old client sends old format, (2) compatibility shim maps to new model but misses field remapping, (3) shim signals deprecation but still returns 200 and zeros => confusing UX.

kevin-infra: Action plan:
- invalidate alias cache for tenant `acme-inc` (they had pinned alias->id mapping in edge cache)
- add quick fix to shim to validate inputs and return 4xx if required fields missing instead of zero scores
- surface `X-Model-Deprecated` as a warning in SDK so clients upgrade

jess-support: I relayed to the customer to upgrade SDK to `redwood-js@1.4.0` as a short-term workaround and to clear any client-side alias cache. They asked for a reproducible test they can run.

maria-ml: Provide this test curl (will fail with zero scores on older runtime):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-live-XXX' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"rerank-legacy","inputs":["reset my password"],"documents":[{"text":"go to settings -> security"},{"text":"reset via email link"}] }'
```
maria-ml: If scores still all 0, send me `req_` id and I'll attach profiler.

deploy-bot: deploy triggered: patch/compat-shim-validate -> staging

jess-support: Thanks team. I'll keep customer updated and will escalate if they see it again after cache invalidation/SDK update. :thumbsup:
